title: AI Taxi Booking Chatbot

included: Conversational flow for pickup/contact, destination/instructions, and pickup time
Provider adapter for OpenAI or Gemini with model-swappable interface
Validation and graceful re-asking for incomplete/ambiguous inputs
POST of validated booking payload to one existing staging API endpoint
End-to-end staging test cases for the agreed payload contract
excluded: geocoding service procurement or paid third-party spend
scope beyond one existing booking endpoint without a paid change order
acceptanceCriteria: Widget collects all three required booking data groups
Ambiguous/missing data triggers targeted re-ask instead of silent acceptance
Validated payload reaches the agreed staging endpoint in the agreed schema
LLM provider can be switched through the adapter/config boundary
Test evidence is supplied for the agreed staging flow

proposal: I can deliver this as a tightly bounded 3-day integration: a lightweight JS chat widget, a provider-neutral LLM adapter (OpenAI or Gemini), strict validation/re-asking for pickup/contact, destination/instructions and pickup time, and a validated POST into one existing staging booking endpoint. I would keep model/API keys out of the browser, use a structured schema so the model cannot silently invent booking fields, and provide staging E2E test evidence plus a concise handoff. D’AUBE SONNTAG can show owned product/system work in React/TypeScript, API automation and AI/RAG integration as capability evidence; I will not represent that work as prior client work. Bid: $299 fixed, 3 days, assuming the staging endpoint and payload contract are available at kickoff. Backend rewrite, routing/fare/payment logic and paid third-party services are outside this fixed scope unless separately agreed.
